uutiset.t: Modi Nears Majority Needed to Increase India’s Parliament Seats
uutiset.s: Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s government moved closer to clearing a contentious law to expand the size of India’s parliament after a regional opposition party declared support for the legislation.

uutiset.t: Norway’s Wealth Fund Again Votes No to Musk’s Tesla Pay Package
uutiset.s: Norway’s $2.2 trillion sovereign wealth fund said it is voting against Elon Musk’s 2025 pay package at Tesla Inc.’s annual meeting next week.

uutiset.t: Plunging Fuel Prices Bring Relief for Drivers and Central Banks
uutiset.s: In a few short weeks, global fuel markets have lurched out of crisis, for now at least.

uutiset.t: Eisenkot Edging Closer to Leading Israel With Talks Progressing
uutiset.s: With just over a week to go, Gadi Eisenkot is within striking distance of a coalition breakthrough that could secure him a parliamentary majority and loosen Benjamin Netanyahu’s three-decade grip on Israeli politics.

uutiset.t: RBI Steps Up Gold Loan Scrutiny as Bullion Rout Signals Strain
uutiset.s: India’s banking regulator is stepping up scrutiny of the nation’s $247 billion gold-loan sector as a sharp drop in bullion prices erodes the collateral that lenders demand from borrowers, according to people familiar with the matter.

uutiset.t: Managing $300B for Ultra Wealthy Families: Masters in Business with Holly MacDonald
uutiset.s: Barry speaks with Holly MacDonald, CEO of Bessemer Trust. They discuss her time working in Brazil and how investing in emerging markets shapes her investment philosophy. uutiset.t: Trump’s AI Gambit Fuels Wild Thanksgiving Week on Wall Street
uutiset.s: The message from Washington this week was unmistakable: America must do whatever it takes to win the artificial-intelligence race with China, and the government is prepared to intervene to make it happen.

uutiset.t: Colombia Peso Stumbles as Mounting Risks Test Rally
uutiset.s: The Colombian peso is headed for its worst month in more than four years as a toxic mix of trouble at home and abroad takes the shine off one of the year’s most resilient currencies.

uutiset.t: Power Outages, Flood Risks Linger as Storm Leaves East Coast
uutiset.s: More than 400,000 homes and businesses along the East Coast are without power after an explosive storm uprooted trees in Queens and Manhattan and inundated commuter rail lines in New Jersey on Thanksgiving Day.

uutiset.t: US Stocks Rebound as Traders Pile Into Battered Tech Shares
uutiset.s: US stocks rallied Friday, capping a week of whiplash as dip buyers scooped up some beaten down technology shares despite lingering worries about the sustainability of the artificial-intelligence boom.

uutiset.t: China Spurs Biggest Stock Gain Since 2024 on Rare Midday Vow
uutiset.s: Chinese authorities gave markets a boost with a rare midday statement pledging support, sending stocks to their best day in more than two years.

uutiset.t: Emerging-Market Stocks Snag Best Week Since June on Tech Rebound
uutiset.s: Emerging-market stocks posted their biggest weekly gain since June as investors piled back into technology shares following a recent selloff, capping a volatile week across global markets.

uutiset.t: Copper Surges Most in Seven Months as Risk Appetite Returns
uutiset.s: Copper climbed the most since April, extending its rebound from an 11-month low earlier this week, as risk appetite returned after a rout fueled by concerns over the artificial intelligence trade.

uutiset.t: Treasuries Drop as Stock Rise Saps Demand for Haven Bonds
uutiset.s: US Treasuries fell as the market reopened after the Thanksgiving holiday, with gains in equities damping demand for haven assets.

uutiset.t: Brazil’s Real Caps Best Week Since 2020 as Trabuco Lifts Mood
uutiset.s: Brazilian markets rallied after President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva picked one of the nation’s most prominent bankers to be his finance minister, easing the worries about his economic policies that triggered a deep selloff after his surprise re-election last month.
